name: Joseph S. Jones
bioAdditions: In Dec 1914 Joseph S. Jones was 33, a headman, born and living in Plymouth; his parents Edward (born Wales) and Margaret ("Kiver") were both dead (S1). The docket thus proves he was a son of Edward F. Jones and Margaret McIver and a brother of Anna C. (Jones) McGuire. FS dates his birth to 1883 (S2).

relationships.evidence: Docket names father Edward, b. Wales
